subject.facility_name: COBALT LODGE HEALTH CARE AND REHABILITATION CENTER

executive_summary.text: CMS lists 59 health citations for this home between 2019-01-14 and 2026-09-02, including 4 at actual harm or immediate jeopardy level (1 immediate jeopardy).
2025-09-08: F-0689 (J) Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
Contract (agency) staff made up 10.6% of nursing hours in 2026Q2 (Connecticut median 3.8%).
PBJ-based estimate was below the Connecticut total direct-care comparison point in 3 quarter(s): 2025Q3, 2025Q4, 2026Q1.

Current ownership interests reported to CMS: MARC ZGORSKI (5% Or Greater Direct Ownership Interest); TODD P ZGORSKI (5% Or Greater Direct Ownership Interest); JOYCE C ZGORSKI (5% Or Greater Direct Ownership Interest).
Cost year 2025: total nursing pool (agency) fees on the report were $846,781, of which $442,011 is counted in direct care.

Missing data: cost years 2015, 2016, 2017 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data); No related parties or management-service payees were read from the cost year 2025 report. That means none were read, not that none exist.

Every year's full detail, including years left out here and the reason, is in https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075232/financials.json.
Built only from public datasets published on danbeem.xyz. Absence of a record means it is not in these datasets, not that it did not happen.
Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

tables.title: Cost-report figures by year

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
